children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may fall to 4,440 ringgit per metric ton, as suggested by a projection analysis and a channel technique.
The downtrend from 4,852 ringgit has developed beyond a falling channel. A duplicated channel points at a target zone of 4,357-4,373 ringgit.
A realistic target is 4,440 ringgit, as the projection analysis on the fall from 4,833 ringgit reveals that the contract has pierced below the 323.6% level of 4,482 ringgit.
Resistance is at 4,507 ringgit, a break above which may lead to a gain into the 4,533-4,549 ringgit range. On the daily chart, the contract has broken a key support at 4,505 ringgit.
The break confirmed an extension of a wave c towards 4,292 ringgit, its 100% projection level.
